messages:
Jared: Following up from today's all-hands finance segment  post your runway/procurement questions here and we'll respond.
Maya: Quick summary: cash runway ~18 months on base plan; downside scenarios and controls in the slide deck.
Noah: Can we get a one-line monthly burn breakdown? payroll vs infra vs go-to-market.
Maya: Monthly ~ $3.2M: payroll ~$1.4M, infra/GPU ~$1.25M, sales/marketing ~$350k, other ~$200k (rounded).
Priya: If bookings slip 15%, what's the immediate playbook?
Jared: Short-term: selective hiring pause, pause large brand bets, renegotiate top vendor contracts. Board notified if runway breaches 12 months.
Lina: Hiring pause details? who approves exceptions?
Maya: Selective pause. Critical infra/customer roles proceed with VP + Finance signoff. All other reqs need VP-level approval + Finance review.
Noah: Procurement thresholds? renewals caused surprises before.
ProcurementBot: New thresholds: purchases > $5k require Finance review; > $25k require Legal + CFO. Auto-hold on renewals > $15k. Submit via https://redwood.internal/procure and tag "expedite" for customer-impacting buys.
Priya: SLA on approvals  last time it took weeks.
FinanceOpsBot: SLA targets: <$5k: 2 business days; $5k$25k: 5 business days; >$25k: 10 business days. Expedited triage for true customer-impacting items (target ~24hrs).
Lina: Delegated manager budgets for tooling? to avoid blocking sprints.
Maya: Managers can approve up to $1k; Directors + Finance for $1k$5k. Above that requires Finance signoff.
Noah: What about buying GPUs (capex) to reduce opex?
Jared: We'll evaluate capex for stable Dedicated pools. Any capex > $200k goes through ROI review and needs board notification.
Priya: Exception process for urgent > $25k purchases?
Maya: Open a procurement ticket, tag @Jared and @Maya, include customer-impact justification and rollback path. We'll triage within 24hrs for true customer-impacting cases.
Jared: We'll publish the updated approval matrix, a short procurement playbook, and a one-page FAQ to #finance-docs and the all-hands notes. DM Maya or me for 1:1s.
Maya: Thanks all  closing thread, feel free to reopen if something urgent pops up.
